runtime_driver:
import DefiKernel.Interleaving.Recovery
import DefiKernel.Parallel.Examples
namespace RecoverySpotCheck
open DefiKernel DefiKernel.Typed DefiKernel.Composition DefiKernel.Parallel
open DefiKernel.Interleaving DefiKernel.Typed.Examples DefiKernel.Parallel.Examples
 def schedules : List Schedule := [
  [.left,.left,.right,.right], [.left,.right,.left,.right], [.left,.right,.right,.left],
  [.right,.left,.left,.right], [.right,.left,.right,.left], [.right,.right,.left,.left]]
 def exactWorld (result : Interleaving.Result Party Asset Domain) (expected : C → ℚ)
     (l r : Obs) : Bool :=
  match result with
  | .refused .. => false
  | .executed _ m => decide ((∀ c, m.world.state.balance c = expected c) ∧
      m.world.capabilities = store ∧ m.left.observe = l ∧ m.right.observe = r)
 def checks : List (String × Bool) := schedules.zipIdx.flatMap fun (s, n) ↦
  let good := runInterleaving cfg boundaries initial [usd 3, usd 2] [shares 4, shares 3] s
  let stopped := runInterleaving cfg boundaries initial [usd 3, usd 8] [shares 4, shares 3] s
  [(s!"interleaving.recovery.success.s{n}",
    exactWorld good (balanceTable 5 5 13 7)
      (observed [leftEvent 0 3 3, leftEvent 1 2 5])
      (observed [rightEvent 0 4 4, rightEvent 1 3 7]) &&
    matchesParallel good (runParallel cfg boundaries initial [usd 3, usd 2] [shares 4, shares 3])),
   (s!"interleaving.recovery.refusal.s{n}",
    exactWorld stopped (balanceTable 7 3 13 7)
      (observed [leftEvent 0 3 3] (failure 1 (usd 8) (.kernel .insufficientFunds)))
      (observed [rightEvent 0 4 4, rightEvent 1 3 7]) &&
    matchesParallel stopped (runParallel cfg boundaries initial [usd 3, usd 8] [shares 4, shares 3]))]
#eval do
 if checks.length != 12 then throw (IO.userError "Wrong recovery spot-check inventory")
 if (checks.map Prod.fst).eraseDups.length != checks.length then
  throw (IO.userError "Duplicate recovery spot-check names")
 for (label, passed) in checks do
  IO.println s!"{label}: {passed}"
 if checks.any (fun item ↦ !item.2) then throw (IO.userError "Recovery spot check failed")
end RecoverySpotCheck
